xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3025: Durable pipeline journal omits verificationStatus — DoD verification row false-MISSes whenever live status is cleared (post-close-out, DB rebuild)

plan.title: Durable pipeline journal omits verificationStatus — DoD verification row false-MISSes whenever live status is cleared
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: markRecordPipelineClosedOutSync (src/lib/pan-dir/record.ts:865) deletes pipeline.verificationStatus at close-out step 8, so once live status is cleared (close-out step 9, or any DB rebuild) DoD row 3 can only observe 'missing' from the journal fallback — reproduced on MIN-896 (pass then MISS four minutes later) and PAN-3018. The mirror chain already carries the verdict end-to-end; the terminal write destroys it. Adjacent same-family defects: row 5's default readMergeStatus reads live status only (dod-gate.ts:105), and re-running pan close on a closed-out issue re-evaluates the gate against post-close state instead of short-circuiting.
narratives.Proposal: Four independent fixes (PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-3025.md): (1) delete the verificationStatus=undefined line from markRecordPipelineClosedOutSync; (2) add verificationStatus:'pending' to reopenWorkspaceState's reset; (3) repoint row 5's default readMergeStatus through the existing loadStatus() live→journal fallback, signature unchanged; (4) add readCompletedCloseOut() helper in dod-gate.ts and a guard at the top of the closeOut() workflow that returns idempotent success (naming closedOutAt) only when pipeline.closedOut === true AND the live row is gone — the two-condition guard preserves the mid-ceremony-abort retry path.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No backfill/repair of historical records that already lost verificationStatus (recoverable from each record's closeOut.dodGate audit)
- No '(from pipeline journal)' source annotation on row 5's observed string (dep-signature change for marginal gain)
- No removal of the server route's label-cache idempotency check (issue-close-out.ts) — the workflow guard is the durable backstop underneath
- No reordering of close-out ceremony steps
- No changes to checkMergedRow canonical-done semantics (PAN-3188) or any other DoD row
- No changes to projectPipeline/durableSubset/pipelineToDurableUpdate — already correct

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the destructive terminal write, not the readers
autoDecisions.rationale: projectPipeline, durableSubset, and pipelineToDurableUpdate already map verificationStatus; records/pan-3018.json proves the verdict existed at close time (closeOut.dodGate shows verification pass) and was deleted by markRecordPipelineClosedOutSync.

autoDecisions.summary: Idempotency guard in the closeOut() workflow, not the CLI
autoDecisions.rationale: One guard covers CLI, dashboard single close-out, and bulk close-out; the server route's label-cache check remains as a fast path above it.

autoDecisions.summary: Guard requires closedOut === true AND live status absent
autoDecisions.rationale: A ceremony aborted between mark-terminal and clear-review-status (recordDodGate failure path) leaves closedOut=true with live status present and must be allowed to complete; live-row absence is the completion witness.
Only the default implementation changes to use loadStatus(); the 8 existing injected-dep test call sites keep working, avoiding churn for a diagnostic annotation of marginal value.

autoDecisions.summary: Row 5 and re-close idempotency included in scope
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's fix item 2 and the MIN-896 comment's row-5 observation are the same defect family (live-only reads vs durable journal); fixing row 3 alone leaves pan close re-runs failing on row 5.
The idempotent short-circuit makes re-running pan close on pre-fix records a no-op, and verdicts remain recoverable from closeOut.dodGate — a repair sweep is scope creep.

Short-circuit closeOut() when the record shows a completed close-out

narrative.Action: Add an exported helper `readCompletedCloseOut(issueId, projectPath): Promise<string | null>` to src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts (imports already present): read the issue record; return null unless pipeline.closedOut === true; then return null if getReviewStatus(issueId) yields a live row (mid-ceremony abort must fall through); otherwise return pipeline.closedOutAt ?? 'unknown'. In src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts closeOut(), as the first statement inside Effect.gen (before the UAT-evidence step): call the helper; on non-null, push stepSkipped('close-out:idempotent', [`Issue already closed out at <ts> — skipping the Definition-of-Done gate and ceremony`]) and return buildResult immediately. workflows.ts is allowlisted at exactly 1006 lines in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt — bump its row to the new count (format `<lines> src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts # PAN-3025`, replacing the PAN-3211 ref only if the parser rejects two refs; verify with bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh). Extend tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts: add controllable readIssueRecord to the pan-dir/record.js mock (lines 96-104) and getReviewStatus to the review-status.js mock (lines 92-94). Cases: (a) closedOut + live null → success, exactly one close-out:idempotent skipped step naming closedOutAt, mockMarkRecordPipelineClosedOutSync and mockClearReviewStatus NOT called; (b) closedOut + live row present → ceremony falls through and the mark-terminal mock IS called; (c) existing close-out tests unchanged.

With closedOut unset, npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts exits 0 with all pre-existing close-out cases unmodified
bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh exits 0 with the workflows.ts allowlist row updated to the new line count referencing PAN-3025
Document verdict durability and idempotent re-close in DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md

narrative.Action: Add a 'Verdict durability' subsection to docs/DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md after the row table stating three things: (1) rows 1-3 read live status first and fall back to the per-issue record's pipeline block on overdeck-state; (2) close-out's terminal journal write preserves the full verdict triple including verificationStatus, so rows still pass after live status is cleared or the DB is rebuilt; (3) re-running pan close on a fully closed-out issue is an idempotent no-op naming the original closedOutAt — it does not re-evaluate the gate against post-close state. No other doc file describes this behavior; nothing else changes.
